nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Cleansing Oil Makeup Remover

avis.titre: Fantastic product for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've been using this to temove my makeup for years and my face loves it. It effectively removes my makeup and spf moisturizer. I use it with dry hands on my dry face, per the directions, and then add water to emulsify before rinsing. I then wash my face with another Clinique face wash and my skin feels great. Its light but effective, and gentle on my eyes and Rosacea.

I enter all of my product ingredient lists in the cosdna website and this is the only oil cleanser that has ZERO....ZERO...acne causing ingredients!!! i have extremely sensitive skin and almost everything breaks me out...except for this product! I hope it never ever gets discontinued. Just make sure you are using a regular cleanser after this one. Always double cleanse.
My skin loves this gentle cleanser. It cleanses thoroughly and leaves my face feeling hydrated. I use it morning and night. It effectively removes makeup and does not irritate my sensitive skin.
This is one of my favorite make up removers, aside from the wipes. It gets every inch of make up off my face and it doesn't take that much to use to remove.

I thought i like this. But ehen i used it ahain i could not get the oul off my face! Even after washing it with face soap it stayed on. I have combo skin and this just disnt do it at all! I like the DHC. No oil and does a pretty good job with my waterproof mascara and makeup.

Okay so first of all anyone who says it doesn't remover eye make up is likely using it wrong. If you massage it into your skin before you dampen your skin with water, it cleans every bit of eye makeup evem waterproof mascara. This stuff is gold and have been using it for years!

Soooo I tried out this product because I've heard its very good. As an employee at Ulta we use this product to remove makeup sometimes on our guests. It does what it claims to do. It removes make up. But it will NOT remove eye makeup, as in mascara, or concealer/foundation around the eye area. It will NOT remove all the make up on ur skin either. So if ur wearing medium-heavy make up you might want to finish off with a make up wipe. I expected more for the price point.
I love this makeup remover. I love thag its a pump and i dont have to dip my fingers in a jar. I love that its not irritating to the eyes. And i love thag it removes all of my makeup.
This oil cleanser has the most beautiful texture & removes makeup, sunscreen, debris & grime effortlessly. I will definitely purchase again. :)
No residue! Skin is comfortable and ready for serums removes bronzer well! No alcohol or fragrance works well on dry sensitive skin

I have dry skin this hydrating does not leave behind and residue. My skin is sensitive I have no issues with redness it's is fragrance free as well and soothes my rosacea! Skin is comfortable and clean removed bronzing foundation and mascara.

I keep buying this! I have oily skin. This takes all my makeup off with out the greasy feeling. It clouds my eyes if I open my eyes while appliying it, but it goes away after I wash my face. Does not irritate my eyes and no greasy residue.

avis.titre: Doesn't cause styes or other eye problems
avis.texte: I have been using this oil for at least 10 or more years. It's never caused a breakout or an eye irritation. I've tried other brands such as Farmacy's Green Clean which although it worked well, it caused a painful stye in my eye which i had to have treated by my eye doctor. He said he's seen women have this issue due to makeup or cleansers. I use several pumps which I rub in, then add warm water, rinse, and fully wipe it off with a wet makeup eraser. I also use a gentle water based eye makeup remover for more stubborn eyeliner which is why I'm only giving 4 stars. It doesn't remove all eye makeup unless you don't use much. I'd recommend this.

avis.titre: Doesn't cause styes or other eye problems
avis.texte: I have been using this oil for at least 10 or more years. It's never caused a breakout or an eye irritation. I've tried other brands such as Farmacy's Green Clean which although it worked well, it caused a painful stye in my eye which i had to have treated by my eye doctor. He said he's seen women have this issue due to makeup or cleansers. I use several pumps which I rub in, then add warm water, rinse, and fully wipe it off with a wet makeup eraser. I also use a gentle water based eye makeup remover for more stubborn eyeliner which is why I'm only giving 4 stars. It doesn't remove all eye makeup unless you don't use much. I'd recommend this.
Makes me feel soft and succulent like a baby's booty! Highly recommend!
Im a little disappointed because This product burns and blurs my eyes. Not sure why, will have to return this item for a refund ir exchange for different product.
I use Double wear foundation and with other cleansers I have to double cleanse - with this oil its one and done - perfectly clean skin

I ordered 3 items from Clinique to get a free gift with purchase. I was nervous about ordering this cleansing oil due to previous comments about it spilling out everywhere during shipping. I did not have that problem thankfully! My cleansing oil didn't spill out and everything was packaged nicely.

avis.titre: Love the product, HATE the shipping
avis.texte: So this is my favorite cleansing oil of all time. It's the best! However, I would never purchase it online from Ulta ever again. Twice, it has come about 1/4-1/3 empty with oil spilled all over the packaging! It's an absolute mess because of Ulta's way of shipping it. They don't secure the pump and put it in a very thin mailer. Not how a cleansing oil should be shipped. I received a refund both times but it was suggested to me by customer service to 'only purchase this product in stores from now on'. Yeah I will, BUT the packaging for shipping still needs to improve on Ulta's end.
Love it! You definitely have to use another cleanser afterwards but it melts the makeup right off.
I just do 2 easy pumps and put it all over my eyes where I had Makeup on it runs down my face so I massage it in and use a cotton pad to take it off.

When I revamped my skin care products I decided to look for oil cleansers without fragrance to limit possible skin irritation. This cleanser is one of the few products I could find at the time. This is a great option for those who double cleanse. I use this to clean off my sunscreen and makeup. Then I follow up with a gentle creamy cleanser.
It dissolves eye makeup without any pushing and pulling of the tissue. Gentle, light touch will remove waterproof eyeliner and shadows.

avis.titre: Buy and Re-Buy and Re-Re-Buy Again
avis.texte: I go through about a bottle every 45 days and have for years and years. Can't recommend this enough. I always keep a bottle on backup in case there are supply issues. Not that it's a huge problem, but this past weekend I went to the store and there was one bottle left. Fortunately, I have a 1/3 bottle left, so I was ok, but I don't want to risk running out. It doesn't cause any kind of skin reaction whatsoever. It doesn't burn or cause any redness. No smell or perfume. Rinses clean. Perfect makeup remover.

This is honestly one of my favorite products and I wouldn't change it. You can be gentle with your skin and it still takes everything off, you do have to spend a little longer when removing mascara if you apply a lot like myself.

I was excited to try this cleansing oil to remove my makeup before following with my Cerave hydrating face wash. While the oil did do a good job of dissolving the makeup, my skin started to breakout horribly after a few days. Whiteheads were popping up all over my face, which does not normally happen. My skin isn't terribly sensitive and I thought the ingredients of this product seemed good -- so I was quite surprised and disappointed when it made me breakout. Aside from the breakout it caused, the oil also clouded my vision when used to remove mascara from my lashes and did cause an uncomfortable feeling in my eyes that I needed to wash out in order to make it go away. If it didn't cause me to breakout so horribly, I would have continued to use this oil because it did do a good job of removing the makeup.
The product does remove makeup,I wish it were a bit more luxurious. Good value for the price.
I use this at nighty to take off all my makeup before I wash my face. It's a great remover and works for a double cleanse as well. I have very dry skin.

I love, love, love this oil based makeup remover! I used to use the balm but find the oil to be better for me. It takes off all my makeup and sunscreen from the day without making my skin feel stripped.
Love all of the Take the Day Off products and this one didn't disappoint. I prefer this over other oil cleansing products.

avis.titre: The only makeup remover I use!
avis.texte: I love this makeup remover. I even use it for heavy eye makeup. Takes it off! Just rinse it well with water like you do the rest of your face and follow up with your normal face wash.

I thought since this was so "high end", it was gonna be amazing. It does the job on removing your makeup on your cheeks and what not, but as far as your eye makeup, it stings every time and I'm blinking a million times after washing my face and completing my routine because it hurts my eyes, and leaves an oily feeling behind. It doesn't completely remove mascara either, and I use Loreal, which is a drugstore brand. I'm almost done with the bottle, and looking forward to getting something else. I love Clinique makeup, but this doesn't work for me. I want to look forward to an easy makeup removal process, not a hassle when I'm tired at night :[

avis.titre: I've been using this for years!
avis.texte: This is the best product to remove ALL makeup. It's a little oily, but rinses clean and works immediately.

avis.titre: Never Take a Day off from using
avis.texte: I use this with a cotton pad and am amazed every time how much make up it removes and how clean my face is after using the remover. Best new stable in my skincare routine.

Although this works, it leaves A LOT of residue behind. I feel like I'm doing more work than with the regular "take the day off" remover due to all of the oil. I'll also mention that my eyes water when using it. It's not harsh and makes your skin glow, but it IS oily. Instead of buying this again I'll get the regular make-up remover solution or balm. It was worth a try.

My face broke out in a horrible rash w/ bumps.. I only used the mini sample version & I ended up tossing the sample. It's nothing but fragranced oil that will probably clog up your pores if you use it too much, better off just cleaning your face with a fragrance free soap if you have sensitive skin (like me)

I am so disappointed. I received a sample of this in an advent collection, and I LOVED it! I primarily wear eye makeup, and this remover was very gentle on my sensitive skin and didn't bother my eyes at all. Unfortunately, the full-size bottle seems to have a different formula. It is extra, extra oily and even though I only use the tiniest amount, I can not get all of the greasiness off without an additional cleansing product. Also, I am incredibly careful about not getting any remover in my eyes, but it still works its way in there and makes my vision cloudy until I flush them out. Finally, the pump dispenser is ridiculous. This was a total waste of thirty-one dollars, and the only reason I'm giving it 3 stars is because it does what it says and the sample size formula was amazing.

I tried other oil cleansers before purchasing this Clinique one mainly because of the price. However, the price for me is worth it. It's a lot of product and it absolutely works. When it isn't in the budget to get this one, I will probably stick with Albolene.
Ive been loving this oil cleanser since 2018 and it never dissapoint!

i've used this a couple times & just 2 pumps broke down all my makeup, including mascara very easily! the formula is very thin so makes it easy to spread all over & work into the skin. i'm very happy with the results! fragrance free as well :)

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again!
avis.texte: I asked for an eye makeup remover and was given this. Eyes burned and blurred for a long time after applying it.

I enjoy this. I loved the Neutrogena oil cleanser but it has been discontinued I guess- I loved the price honestly. This is nicer in formulation in that it rinses off easily and don't sud up in order to leave the skin, which I believe is helping to prevent drying of my skin. The neutrogena could be prone to leaving my skin drier than before. I have not used this to solely take my makeup off, I always use Micellar water to remove my makeup, let my skin dry for a minute, then go in with this. I like to really massage my face for 1-2 minutes with this before rinsing and following up with a very gentle LRP cream cleanser. It has not broken my skin out or causes and irritation.

I currently have this and the balm in my shower. For waterproof mascara and heavier makeup days, it takes me MANY pumps of the oil to break it all down (and when I say heavier makeup I mean I wore concealer under my eyes and set it with powder lol, not anything too crazy!) I wouid highly recommend the balm as opposed to the oil if you want the product to last longer/not run out of your hand as you bring it to your face. Without my makeup eraser cloth, I would be scrubbing at my face for even longer.

avis.titre: Returned because of the cystic acne
avis.texte: I returned this because it made me break out with cystic acne. This was my attempt at a double cleansing method but I'm going to stick to micellar water with a cream cleanser.

This does get makeup off fairly easy, but I did have some trouble getting glue off my eyelash line from wearing fake eyelashes. My biggest complaint of all is that after I use this product, it makes my eyes feel heavy and tired.

This works well for removing make up. Other products do not seem to do as good a job at removing all of the eye make up I am wearing. I would prefer to spend less but not have found a drug store product that works as well.

avis.titre: Use if you have oily skin!
avis.texte: I use one-two pumps of this first and then follow up with Cliniques facial soap. I have oily skin and this just takes it away without drying out. Be sure to cleanse after using the cleansing oil

avis.titre: The best for oil cleansing and removing makeup
avis.texte: My favorite oil for cleansing and removing all my makeup at the end of the day. This oil doesn't disappoint.

I tried using this in my double cleansing method (washing with a water based cleanser after this oil) and while it did a great job taking off my makeup, it caused cystic acne on my face which I am not prone to. Going to return this item.

This is definitely worth the price - it lasts forever, takes off all of my makeup and doesn't bother my eyes like the balm to oil one does. I use this to take off my makeup then double cleanse with an actual cleanser. I will probably never use another makeup remover.

I use this as my first part of a cleanse. I love that it removes waterproof makeup. And it rinses off too - it isn't greasy. I found a little pump or two instantly cleans my sponges and brushes too! No scrubbing and ruining my tools!

A little goes a long way. I've used this for months and I'm barely an inch down the bottle. I love that the pump locks for travelling. Nonscented. It delivers on it's promises to remove makeup gently. I also appreciate that it cuts down on my daily waste of using a makeup wipe.

I'm a firm believer in the double cleanse method. But I tend to switch between a balm and a cleansing oil. I've always used other oils (Tula, Julep and other K-beauty brands) but thought I would try this since I've used the Clinique balm before. I was impressed at how effective it is! It's not stripping and it feels very smooth without being greasy, if that makes sense. I also love that it's fragrance-free, which is always a nice option to have. I'm 40 with combination acne-prone skin and this hasn't been an issue at all. Clinique products are usually pretty tried and true for me. Not sure why I never scooped this up before. But I'll definitely be including it in my skincare arsenal going forward.

only make up remove i'll use. i have acne prone sensitive combo skin (fun right?) this stuff takes off everything! use a few pumps on dry hands and dry face. massage for a minute and then add a little water and massage for another minute. optional but you can go in with a water-based cleanser after. hasn't broken me out or anything. love that it's fragrance and dye free.

I've used many makeup remover items. They either made my skin feel greasy and dry. But not this one. My face always feels clean and smooth. I even have my sister in law and niece using it. They love it just as much as I do.

avis.titre: I have found my holy grail
avis.texte: I don't have "acne" problems, but, I have struggled finding a cleanser for the longest time, I know this is meant to take off makeup but I use it to just wash away the day, my skin is left soft and feeling amazing. I've tried everything cerave, cetaphil, neutrogena, fresh, lush, etc, etc... nothing compares! My forehead bumps that I got from all these other cleansers has diminished to just a few, after less than a week of use. I use this in conjunction with day and night L'Oreal moisturizer and Evian facial spray, and, occasionally the ordinary treatments. If you have problems keeping your skin smooth, give this a try, doubt you'll regret.
I use the product as an end of the day cleaning of all the makeup, etc.

I use this as a makeup remover and overall cleansing oil. My one complaint is that the nozzle is faulty on mine (hopefully just mine). When you press it down, it moves to the side and squirts oil to the side; even when I anticipate the movement it will move the other way?? Not like any dispenser I've ever used. It has gotten a few tops oily and that's frustrating.

I really like using this cleansing oil as both a makeup remover and as the first step in the double cleansing method. For me, it's the perfect oil consistency. Only 4 pumps to remove a full face of makeup. It's thin, spreads out nicely when applied to the skin and it's fragrance free. It dissolves all my face makeup/mascara (can't speak for waterproof) sunscreen, etc... beautifully. It rinses off clean with water and leaves your skin ready for a water cleanser. I personally don't like the thicker oil formulas for make-up removal. However, as a deep pore cleanser, I will use a mixture of this cleansing oil along with a few drops of castor oil to create a thicker consistency, massage for 15-20 minutes to loosen up those impurities, steam face and then water cleanse. My pores are so clean after this! Also, this oil doesn't irritate or burn my eyes, which is a plus. NOTE: If you wear contacts, I suggest taking them out before removing your eye makeup or you'll have a hard time cleaning all the oil from your contacts properly. NOTE 2: Cleansing Oils are meant to be followed up with a water based cleanser to correctly remove and dissolve all the residue that an oil cleanser leaves behind. Namely, the double cleansing method.

Sooo worth it, and I haven't found a cheaper oil cleanser that does the job better than this one. Smooth and easy to remove. Doesn't hurt too bad if you accidentally get in your eyes and is really gentle!
I use this as as a first cleanse in the evening to wash away sunscreen and makeup.
I love this ! It's a little heavy on the lids, but leaves my face super clean.

I love that this is not super thick and greasy, but removes my makeup really nicely. Once emulsified it turns into a milky substance and you'll see your mascara and lipstick melting everywhere! I always follow with a water based cleanser after to remove the oil feel. After that there is zero residue unlike other oil cleaners. A huge plus is that it is non-comedogenic so it will not clog pores!

avis.titre: Love how well it removes make up but gives break outs
avis.texte: Works great on removing make up but cause break outs like nothing else. Even if I use micellar water and cleanser after still gives you the worst acne.

I have severely oily and acne prone skin. I used to use DHC cleansing oil, but it broke me out mostly bc my skin didn't like the mineral oil in that one and also it was so thick I was rubbing my face so much and making my skin even redder and acne hurt more. I like this oil because it is soooo thin and slides over my face very well, and will clean out stuff from my pores in a minute. It's a lifesaver!

I take my face makeup off with this, and I honestly love it. It's silky and smooth and really takes off most of my makeup. Been using it for two years now and I love it. You also get a free gift with purchase which is a plus!
I was skeptical at first until I used it. Takes all my makeup off and leaves my skin super soft. No heavy perfume smell either.

I ordered this and the Clinique moisturizing gel and it was supposed to come with 2 free gifts. What they shipped me was a three pack of some weird hair product I didn't order. When I reached out about getting my real order shipped they were rude, wouldn't send the free gifts and never apologized or took any responsibility for sending the wrong thing. They did reship the 2 products I ordered but both were open and used! I won't be ordering from ULTA ever again. Read other reviews, this seems to happen a lot.

avis.titre: LOVE it! Not too oily and works great!
avis.texte: This takes off my makeup great. Its not too oily and it like gets milky when you add water. I then follow with step one in my 3 steps

avis.titre: Love this but wish it were less $$$
avis.texte: This is so far my favorite cleansing oil. I prefer it t the balm because as far as I know it doesn't contain micro plastics. It's also not hard to rub in like a lot of other cleansing oils or balms I've tried! Definitely use a second cleanse with this though ... of course. Will repurchase but I do wish it were a bit less expensive! $20 or under. 🤷🏻‍♀️

This cleansing oil removed my makeup so easily and so gently!!! I wear a lot of makeup just on a daily basis and makeup wipes are too harsh on my skin. But, when I tried this is absolutely fell in the love!! This removed my makeup without any harsh rubbing or anything like that and just did the trick! I also have sensitive, combination skin and I never had a problem with this oil and I've been using it for almost a week now and have absolutely no complaints!!

I have very oily thick skin. This product is so heavy and thick that I can't get it to completely rinse off. However, it does break up all my makeup and doesnt have a strong smell. I personally wouldn't buy again but it is a good product.

I used to use the Burt's Bees cleansing oil, and I hated the smell of that stuff. It was effective to an extent, but this Clinique Take the Day Off Cleansing Oil has virtually no scent, takes off my waterproof mascara (let it have time to dissolve the mascara), and I use the CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser to double cleanse. These two products work together to deliver wonderful results. I'm very pleased with the Clinique cleansing oil.

avis.titre: Not as effective as actual oils
avis.texte: I'm not getting as deep of a clean as I have with other cleansers, and it shows in the size/appearance of my pores. I didn't realize when I bought it that it doesn't actually contain any recognizable oils, it just has the texture of an oil. It's totally unscented and light in texture, if that's important to you, but it's not moisturizing at all, and not as effective as a true oil.
This remover is great. I use it nightly to take off eye makeup. It removes makeup quickly and easily.

I religiously used makeup wipes for ages, but my skin hated them. I switched to micellar water a few years ago but was never really felt totally makeup free after using it. (my eyelashes always felt crusty after and my lids were red). I decided to pick this up on an impulse and after the first use I'm a believer. My face felt super clean immediately and all my eye makeup was gone. Super gentle and didn't aggravate my eyes at all. Highly recommend.

I use this product to remove my make up at night and omg it melts it right off!!! This product not only takes my makeup off but it also cleanses my skin as it does it and although it's oil, after rinsing it off you don't feel oily at all! Obviously follow up with your own night cleanser but overall this product is a MUST HAVE! Súper light weight and i honestly feel that it detoxes my skin every night! I wake up woth amazing clean smooth skin!

I used Boscia's Makeup Breakup Cool Cleansing Oil for years, but there was some weird point in time where it was sold out. I needed something fast, and found this. Saved a couple bucks, too! Been using this for 2 years now. It's lightweight, rinses clean, and is the perfect beginning to my double cleanse. It has never made me break out and I appreciate that it's unscented. For reference, I have oily, sensitive skin.
made my skin a lot oilier than i thought. if you have oily skin this is not for you
This is the perfect oil cleanser! It works so well! Just remember to use another cleanser afterwards so that there is no leftover oil!

I suffer from rosacea and I was struggling finding something gentle to remove my makeup. Since I have rosacea I wear makeup daily to cover the redness. I love to use this as part of my double cleansing. I apply this oil and then massage my face until the makeup is dissolved. Then I rinse my face with lukewarm water. I then apply a gentle cleanser and cleanse. Pat dry! Immediately put on moisturizer.

Love this product. For the most part, my skin is usually dry with a couple oily patches in summer (Texas). Works great no matter if it's a light day of make-up or caked on. The pump top makes it so easy to squirt a bit on your fingers (I don't use cotton rounds) and go in with a bit more, if needed. No sensitivities when used on my lids or around my eyes. Gently washes away with water and doesn't leave me feeling greasy before going in with my cleanser.
I like it but the part where it comes out is a little unnecessary if you don't cover it it will squirt far and make a mess
So happy to have found this stuff! Makeup wipes were ok, but this stuff melts the make up off of my face, helping me to remove every last bit.

My friend that is an esthetician recommended this to me and at first I was skeptical because I do have combo skin and very sensitive skin at that. However, I wanted to stop using makeup wipes because they tug at the skin and always break me out even after cleansing afterwards. I started using this with my skincare line and the makeup comes off so easy! Even waterproof mascara that usually won't budge with makeup wipes! I did purge the first day or two because my skin was not used to the double cleansing but after that no more bumps! I absolutely love this product and I feel like it's definitely worth a shot if you are looking for an alternative makeup remover.

avis.titre: I've been using this for years, it's fine
avis.texte: I've been using this for about five years. I have tried other oils and micellar waters as attempts to replace this (Posay, Garnier, Coconut Oil, Almond Oil, TTDO Balm/Milk, Lancome) and none of them work as well as this. That being said, it's not out of this world. It works well enough. I always wake up with a little mascara under my eyes the next morning (I don't use waterproof mascara), so it's eh. But it doesn't hurt my eyes, my skin doesn't mind it, and removing a little mascara every morning isn't terrible. It also doesn't take my eyelashes and eyebrows when I use it. However if I found something to replace this, I would. It isn't worth the price, but it's good enough.

I've used this product for two years. I previously used the clinique cleaning balm as well. This is the only cleansing oil I will trust. Yes, it's greasy - it's an oil! I suffer from large, clogged pores and get breakout here and there. I massage this onto my face for about two minutes. That may seem like a long time, but I treat myself to a facial massage as I work the product into my skin. I do follow up with a double cleanse from another brand cleanser that has more active ingredients. I feel that the oil cleans my pores so that my active ingredients can penetrate my skin deeper. I won't be switching oil cleansers anytime soon!

avis.titre: Works to take makeup off but....
avis.texte: The oil takes my makeup off but I cannot remove my eye makeup with out oil getting in my eyes and creating a film on my contacts and eyes. I close my eyes but the oils still seems to make a film on my eyes and contacts.

I use this every night to remove my makeup! I apply to dry skin and then immediately wash my face with Dove sensitive skin soap. My skin has never felt cleaner! I highly recommend. I like this product so much that I bought a bottle for my mom for Christmas!!

This is the only remover I will ever use on my eyes. I have long lashes, and waterproof mascara keeps them from being weighed down. So I need a great remover that is gentle and doesn't irritate my eyes. I've tried LOTS of different removers, and this is hands-down the very best

avis.titre: Melts eyeliner away like no other I've tried
avis.texte: Remove make up at the end of the day. Leaves face clean but not dry. Refreshing.

avis.titre: Broke me out and barely removed makeup
avis.texte: I love Clinique, especially their Acne Solutions line, but this cleansing oil did nothing but irritate my skin and spread around my makeup. My skin is oily and acne prone, for reference.
I've been using this product for quite some time and love it. It feels like oil, but it rinses off in a flash and doesn't leave an oily residue. Take off all makeup easily.

avis.titre: 2nd Bottle: Last one lasted me a year & I wear makeup daily
avis.texte: This is my second bottle. My first one lasted a year and I wear a lot of makeup daily.
I love this oil. It makes my skin feel so clean after using this and then a gentle cleanser. My skin has never felt softer and cleaner! It's not irritating at all
I use t to remove make up in the evening, and sometimes in the morning for light massage with massage tool. Removes make up very well. I love it!

I loved this make up remover!! Before using it I was using a micellar water make up remover because using wipes sometimes irritates my skin. When I started using water proof mascara I bought this along with it and fell in love. I was originally afraid it would make me break out because it's oil based but my skin has been so clear since using the product and it does a great job taking off my waterproof mascara along with my face make up. The only con I found was it does leave a oil film over my eyes for a few minutes but I have not found an oil based make up remover that hasn't before.

avis.titre: I would purchase this product again.
avis.texte: I found my favorite cleansing oil! This removes all my makeup without irritating my skin. I have very sensitive skin so I like that this is fragrance free. Also it rinses off easily without leaving a residue.

avis.titre: removes everything and perfect for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I moved away from makeup remover wipes because they were irritating my skin. I researched and found about the double cleansing method (oil for removing makeup and cleanser). The first time I tried this Clinique cleansing oil was in store, on makeup on my hand. I was so impressed and decided it to try it. I lovee that it doesn't irritate my sensitive skin (rosacea, combo - dry cheeks, oily T zone). I already repurchased it

I love Clinque products but this product was not my favorite. It's messy and burns your eyes. It takes forever to get your eye make up off with (and I don't wear a lot of make up). I would recommend 'take the day off' regular make up remover instead of this oil cleansing product.
This product may seem like it is oily, but all makeup comes off immediately and you are not left oily or greasy! Highly recommend.

This is my 2nd bottle. I switched from the cleansing balm. Not that I didn't mind the balm but the warming up the balm was annoying at time. Might as well skip the step with the oil. Does a wonderful job of removing all my makeup. Doesn't clog my pores(a lot of ingredients cause acne for me). No noticeable scent. Easy to wash off and no residue left over. I only have some difficult removing waterproof mascara but about 95% of the mascara is removed the first time. So it's still worth it for me. The dispenser also has the ability to lock close so there are no accident spills. But it's tricky for traveling because all you need to do to "unlock", is to simply turn the dispenser which can cause some spills in luggage

avis.titre: I really won't buy this product any time soon.
avis.texte: This eyeshadow remover is good. I do prefer using Clinique's other eyeshadow better.
I like how gentle is the product to the skin and also you feel how soft it leaves your skin while it melts away any makeup or sunblock leftovers. I am happy to add it to my beauty regimen.
I like the balm for travel but I love this for home. This is probably my 5th repurchase. Makeup slides right off and rinses nicely.

Makeup wipes just smear makeup around and make you tug and rub on your skin. This cleansing oil gently breaks down the makeup allowing your following cleanse to be even more effective. Doesn't have any fragrance or leave a residue, it just suits all my needs.

This is a great gentle cleanser. I have been using it for years to remove makeup before double cleansing with a regular gentle cleanser. Removes all makeup quickly and easily. I have dry, sensitive skin and it doesn't leave my skin feeling stripped. Would definitely recommend!
I occasionally try other oil cleansers to remove makeup, but I always come back to this one. It's effective, and I love that it's fragrance free. Will continue to repurchase!

I liked the pump bottle. Used this for a week on my eye makeup only and it takes the makeup off well but is very messy. My eyes became very dry and irritated. Have sensitive skin and was recommended this bottle but wouldn't try again.

Made sure to read the label...nothing mentioned about avoiding eyes... used it once to remove my eye makeup and as I blinked this white film formed in my eyes... no burning or stinging but it wouldn't go away until I used water and eyedrops to rinse my eyes... very scary when you trust a product like this!!
